why: The project maps @/ to src/ (tsconfig paths and the vite.config.ts alias), so '@/utils' is the same module as '../utils': Cart.tsx imports formatPrice and every price goes through it. No problems in the status bar.

files.shop/vite.config.ts:
import { defineConfig } from 'vite'
import react from '@vitejs/plugin-react'
import path from 'path'

export default defineConfig({
  plugins: [react()],
  resolve: { alias: { '@': path.resolve(__dirname, './src') } },
})
